plugins/solplanetbe/plugin_info/configur.Secondes avant d'abandonner un appel à l: Seconds before giving up on a call to the communication stick. It sits on your local network: it answers within tens of milliseconds, or not at all. Five seconds are enough, and no more are needed — the cron that polls the devices runs every minute and is shared with the other plugins.

plugins/solplanetbe/desktop/php/solplane.Créez les appareils trouvés. Les command: Create the devices found. Commands are added right away, and the first reading follows immediately.
plugins/solplanetbe/desktop/php/solplane.La clé est alimentée par l'onduleur : su: The stick is powered by the inverter: on an installation without a battery, it goes off with the sun. When ticked, production drops back to zero in the evening instead of staying frozen on the last value. Untick it for a hybrid inverter, which stays on at night: there, no answer would be a real fault. Energy meters are never reset to zero.
